M6 at L about 1.5 um gives an intrinsic gain near 49 dB, so PSRR is about 95 dB. Current budget: 10 uA ref + 8 uA tail + 22 uA output = 40 uA, about 72 uW. Cc = 1.2 pF sets GBW near 6 MHz. Rz cancels the RHP zero, so phase margin is above 70 degrees. Slew rate is at least 6.6 V/us."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "Itail": (8e-6, 4e-6, 14e-6),
    "Lm":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid6": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),
    "L6":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
    "I6":    (22e-6, 14e-6, 28e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    gmn = 12.0  # NMOS bias mirrors

    # NMOS bias: ibias diode, tail, output current source (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.28)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.45)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lm"], It / 2, vds=1.1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lm"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    # output PMOS CS
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / m6.gm
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL)) / (2 * PI)
    dz = Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if dz > 1e-9 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3))
    power = vdd * (Iref + It + I6)
    psrr = A1 * m6.gm / m6.gds
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m1.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) * 0.5
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    vth_n = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * 0.8 * 2 / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)
    noise = math.sqrt(vth_n) * 3.0  # thermal + flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 5.5 * tau
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": db(psrr), "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing, "settle": settle}
```
